From the Cotton family to yours: have a wonderful Good Friday as we remember Christ's ultimate sacrifice for us all. 

Romans 5:8: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

The New York Times just confirmed what we've long suspected: ActBlue knowingly let in fraudulent foreign donations to help Democrats win. 

Yet another example of the left's embrace of fraud.

Everyone involved must face the full weight of the law.

President Trump is absolutely right. 

Iran has been killing thousands of Americans for 47 years.

Stopping Iran from being a threat will make America safer and more prosperous.
President Trump to Presidents Obama and Biden on Iran:

Forcing the Trump admin to restore “legal status” for illegals admitted through Biden’s illegal app is an assault on U.S. sovereignty. 

Even by activist judge standards, this ruling is outrageous and should be immediately overturned.

 The Left wants open borders back.

A criminal illegal alien killed two Arkansans last week while driving drunk. 

This is outrageous and it was preventable.

There's nothing compassionate about the Democrats' open-border policies that allowed millions of criminal illegal aliens to come to the U.S.

Remember: Iran is a terrorist revolutionary regime that has been killing Americans by the thousands for decades. 

President Trump didn't start this war. He's finally fighting back.

The Democrats' refusal to pay TSA agents is based on one thing: Democrats want to bring back Biden's open border policies. 

It will never happen.

Kamala Harris was responsible for Biden's open borders chaos and Biden's record inflation. 

It's surprising to see Arkansas Democrats fully embrace Kamala Harris. 

Voting for any Democrat in Arkansas is voting for Kamala Harris's policies.

Chuck Schumer should apologize to the millions of Americans forced to wait for hours at airports. 

Schumer is directly responsible. 

He cares more about helping criminal illegal aliens and appeasing the far-left than he cares about national security.
